messages.subject: size effect for 2 groups
parts:
Dear INLA community, 

I'm trying to create a model which has a different effect of habitat on two different size classes. Additionally it has also a random walk year effect per size class. However, the size effect per habitat gives an error when I try to create the stack ("Error in (function (data, A, effects, tag = "", compress = TRUE, remove.unused = TRUE)  : ncol(A) does not match nrow(effect) for block 2: 1 != 0"), anyone could help me out?

code:

Xmatrix11 <- model.matrix(~ lsurface + fhabitatsmall + fhabitatlarge, data=subset_fData)
X11 <- as.data.frame(Xmatrix11[,-1]) 
names(X11) <- c(gsub("[:]",".",names(X11)))
head(X11)

Stk11 <- inla.stack(tag = "Fit",
                 data = list(y = subset_fData$NoAtLength),
                 A = list(1,1,Diagonal(length(subset_fData$small), subset_fData$small),Diagonal(length(subset_fData$large), subset_fData$large)),
                 effects = list(
                   Intercept=rep(1,N), 
                   X11 = X11,
                   yearsm= subset_fData$ffishingyear,
                   yearl = subset_fData$ffishingyearlarge))


Thanks in advance, Bram Parmentier
